output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply' += mintedAmount operation can cause it to overflow, reducing the value users think they have in the token contract to a zero balance.

The '_transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large value, the _from -= _value operation can cause it to overflow, reducing it to a negative value, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.

The 'transfer' function calls the '_transfer' function, inheriting its integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large value, the _from -= _value operation can cause it to overflow, reducing it to a negative value, allowing attackers to manipulate balances.
